hypothesis: AI-related companies more frequently outperform SPY before earnings and underperform SPY afterward than the comparison sample.
classification: Manual present-day AI exposure hypothesis: chips, cloud, enterprise AI and consumer AI platforms. Broad subjective cohort, not historical industry membership; Apple is a broad-exposure inclusion. Comparison companies may also use AI.
primary_measure: Fraction of paired events with pre_runup excess_return > 0 AND post_event excess_return < 0
status: Exploratory same-period follow-up after inspecting original pilot; no confirmatory significance claims or untouched holdout. No parameter tuning.
